quarterly_data.signal: The European Commission approved AstraZeneca and Daiichi Sankyo's Enhertu (trastuzumab deruxtecan) as monotherapy for adults with previously treated unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive (IHC 3+) solid tumours who have no satisfactory treatment options, following the positive CHMP opinion; the company calls it the first tumour-agnostic HER2-directed therapy and ADC in the EU (company claim). The approval is based on IHC 3+ subgroups of three Phase II trials: DESTINY-PanTumor02 confirmed ORR 52.3% with median duration of response 21.1 months (n=111), DESTINY-Lung01 ORR 52.9% with median DOR 6.9 months (n=17) and DESTINY-CRC02 ORR 46.9% with median DOR 5.5 months (n=64), with no new safety concerns. Daiichi Sankyo's Ken Keller said Enhertu is now approved for six indications in the EU. EU reviews of Enhertu plus pertuzumab in 1st-line HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer (DESTINY-Breast09) and of the post-neoadjuvant residual-disease setting (DESTINY-Breast05) were under way.
